name: Gyōda (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Gyōda city emblem in red: a four-pointed star with curved arms, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Gyōda, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 April 1949.

features.role: Gyōda city emblem — a four-pointed star with curved arms, like a stylised character
